sources.title: Afghanistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Singapore
sources.officialityEvidence: Singapore MFA's live destination advisory is addressed to Singaporeans, dated 17 September 2024, and contains its current entry-and-exit direction.
sources.supportingExcerpt: contact your travel agency, or the Embassy of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan in Jakarta

sources.title: Entry requirements - Afghanistan travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The live GOV.UK FCDO entry page expressly scopes its information to travellers on full British-citizen passports from the United Kingdom.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is required to enter Afghanistan. The Afghan embassy in London is closed.

sources.title: Afghanistan travel advice and advisories
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government of Canada destination page was last updated 29 July 2026 and separately identifies the regular Canadian-passport entry requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You must obtain a visa to visit Afghanistan. Tourist visa: Required

sources.title: Viaggiare Sicuri: Afghanistan entry requirements
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Crisis Unit
sources.officialityEvidence: MAECI's live passport-specific Afghanistan PDF identifies the visa requirement for Italian travellers but does not identify a present visitor issuing channel.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Il visto è obbligatorio. Di recente, si sono verificati respingimenti di cittadini italiani muniti di visto.

sources.title: Afghanistan travel advice
sources.officialityEvidence: Ireland.ie publishes the Department of Foreign Affairs' live destination advice for Irish citizens and identifies the closure of the nearest cited Afghan mission.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is required to enter Afghanistan. Afghanistan does not have an Embassy in Ireland.

sources.title: Afghanistan: travel and security advice
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Federal Foreign Office page addresses German nationals, but expressly limits its entry section to rules existing before August 2021 which it only believes remain applied.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Angaben beziehen sich auf die bis August 2021 bestehende Regeln

sources.title: Afghanistan - travel information
sources.publisher: Royal Norwegian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Norwegian Government country advice says some Afghan embassies still issue visas but explicitly warns that this can change at short notice.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Noen afghanske ambassader utsteder fremdeles visum, men dette kan endre seg på kort varsel.

unresolved.reason: Singapore MFA directs travellers to verify their purpose-specific entry rules with a travel agent or Afghan Embassy in Jakarta; it neither states the ordinary Singapore-passport visa liability nor establishes a current issuing route or timing.
